contracts.docstring: Actual CI cannot read synthetic host credentials, the host DB or foreign data, write protected Git, inherit secret environment or use exterior networking.
Exercise preparation, capture, two isolated checks and closure within a bounded integration deadline; mutation invalidates only its check copy.
A live grant from the configured factory reads only its project, rejects scope substitution and becomes unusable on withdrawal.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. No frontend changes in this delivery; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
